benchmark.name: OlympicArena Physics

summary.en: OlympicArena Physics evaluates bilingual, multimodal olympiad physics problem solving on the official test split.
summary.zh: OlympicArena Physics 在官方 test split 上评估双语、多模态奥赛物理题解能力。

task_format.en: The model solves English or Chinese olympiad physics questions with original visual inputs and returns an answer in the prescribed type-specific format.
task_format.zh: 模型解决带原始视觉输入的中英文奥赛物理题，并按答案类型规定的格式返回结果。

explanation.en: Fixed-answer outputs are rule-matched and heterogeneous other answers use the pinned GPT-4V judge; the score is Physics test accuracy.
explanation.zh: 固定答案由规则匹配，其他复杂答案使用固定 GPT-4V judge；分数是 Physics test accuracy。

observations.evaluation_protocol: OlympicArena official test split, Physics subject, LMM setting with original images, official zero-shot prompts, temperature 0 and answer extraction. Validation, combined-paper, caption, and text-only rows are excluded.
observations.eligibility_reason: Capability eligibility uses the dated curated observation and canonical protocol; reported-result eligibility requires result_public_date.
observations.notes: Operational evaluation timeline only; not a historical public-result date.

benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
